Name: Mizu's Alpaca and Llama
Author: MizuJakkaru
Description:
[center]﻿﻿[img]https://imgur.com/QO3hCLy.png[/img][/center]
It's a double feature! Be careful, they spit! This mod is for you if you like all things about alpacas and llamas! It adds alpacas and llamas as a new [b]barn [/b]animal. It's configurable, you can have both or either as you prefer. It also contains an optional cryptid called a pushmi-pullyu.

[list]
[*]Alpaca and llama can be shorn for [b]Alpaca Wool[/b] or [b]Llama Wool [/b]every three days. This can be spun into [b]Alpaca Yarn [/b]or [b]Llama Yarn[/b] on the [b]Loom.[/b][/*]
[*]High friendship causes Alpaca and Llama to [b]grow wool faster![/b][/*]
[*]Four cooking recipes to find from the [b]Bookseller.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Marnie [/b]will add them to her stock after you complete the [b]Special Order: Softest Cloth.[/b][/*]
[*](Optional) Pushmi-pullyu shed [b]Rainbow Fleece[/b] every five days. This can be spun into [b]Prismatic Cloth[/b] on the [b]Loom.[/b][/*]
[*](Optional) [b]Marnie [/b]will add them to her stock after you unlock either alpaca and/or llamas and befriend Jas, Vincent, and Wizard to at least three hearts.[/*]
[/list][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300][b]Special Power Utilities[/b][/url] [b]is required to play this mod. [/b]It allows the recipe book to be dynamic between configuration options.

This mod has optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] compatibility, with 4 new recipes to find and cook up. These recipes use all vanilla items (+ alpaca or llama meat) or, if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia[/url] installed, some of them will change to use those items instead.
[center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/OGZGOGL.png[/img][/b][/center]
By default the Alpaca and Llama are enabled and the Pushmi-pullyu is disabled. By default the White and Black Alpaca and the Brown and Piebald Llama appearances are enabled. You can toggle on more below.

[b]Enable Alpaca [/b](true by default): Enables the Alpaca content.
[b]Enable Llama [/b](true by default): Enables the Llama content.
[b]Enable Pushmi-pullyu [/b](false by default): Enables the Pushmi-pullyu content. Requires either alpaca or llama to also be enabled.
[b]Enable Blonde Alpaca [/b](false by default): Enables the Blonde Alpaca texture and adds it to the possible alpaca appearances.
[b]Enable Brown Alpaca [/b](false by default)[b]:[/b] Enables the Brown Alpaca texture and adds it to the possible alpaca appearances.
[b]Enable Pink Alpaca [/b](false by default)[b]:[/b] Enables the Pink Alpaca texture and adds it to the possible alpaca appearances.
[b]Enable Blonde Llama [/b](false by default): Enables the Blonde Llama texture and adds it to the possible alpaca appearances.
[b]Enable White Llama  [/b](false by default)[b]:[/b] Enables the White Llama texture and adds it to the possible alpaca appearances.
[b]Enable Blue Llama [/b](false by default)[b]:[/b] Enables the Blue Llama texture and adds it to the possible alpaca appearances.
[center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/KY9I9jB.png[/img][/b][/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ 
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300]Special Power Utilities[/url]
4. (Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] for some bonus features
5. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
6. (Optional) Download the Animal Husbandry .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
7. When starting up the game for the first time, use Generic Mod Config Menu to choose which options you want to turn on or off.
You're ready to play!

To remove this mod, you can just delete it from your mod folder. Any animals and items still left in your save file will [b]safely[/b] be left behind as error items, which can be thrown away or sold by right clicking on animals.

Deleted it by accident? No problem! Just reinstall the mod, and your error items will become normal items again. It's that easy!
